FOREWORD 
Dear Pupil, 
Rwanda Basic Education Board is honoured to present to you 
this English book for Primary One which serves as a guide to 
competence based teaching and learning to ensure consistency 
and coherence in the learning of English subject. The Rwandan 
educational philosophy is to ensure that you achieve full potential 
at every level of education which will prepare you to be well 
integrated in society and exploit employment opportunities. 
The Government of Rwanda emphasizes the importance of 
supporting teaching and learning materials with the syllabus to 
facilitate your learning process. Many factors influence what 
you learn, how well you learn and the competences you acquire. 
Those factors include instruction materials available. Special 
attention was paid to the activities that facilitate the learning 
process in which you can develop your ideas and make new 
discoveries during concrete activities carried out individually 
or with peers. 
In competence-based curriculum, learning is considered as 
a process of active building and developing knowledge and 
meanings by the learner where concepts are mainly introduced 
by an activity, a situation or a scenario that helps the learner 
to construct knowledge, develop skills and acquire positive 
attitudes and values. 
For effective use of this textbook, your role is to: 
Work on given activities which lead to the development of skills;
• Share relevant information with other learners through 
presentations, discussions, group work and other active 
learning techniques such as role play, case studies, 
investigation and research in the library, from the internet 
or from your community;

• Participate and take responsibility for your own learning;
• Draw conclusions based on the findings from the learning
activities.
I wish to sincerely extend my appreciation to the people 
who contributed towards the development of this textbook, 
particularly REB staff who organized the whole process from its 
beginning. Special gratitude goes to illustrators and designers 
who carefully worked to successful completion of this textbook. 
Any comment or contribution would be welcome for the 
improvement of this textbook for the next edition. 
Dr. MBARUSHIMANA Nelson
Director General, REB

FOREWORD 
Dear Pupil, 
Rwanda Basic Education Board is honoured to present to you 
this English book for Primary One which serves as a guide to 
competence based teaching and learning to ensure consistency 
and coherence in the learning of English subject. The Rwandan 
educational philosophy is to ensure that you achieve full potential 
at every level of education which will prepare you to be well 
integrated in society and exploit employment opportunities. 
The Government of Rwanda emphasizes the importance of 
supporting teaching and learning materials with the syllabus to 
facilitate your learning process. Many factors influence what 
you learn, how well you learn and the competences you acquire. 
Those factors include instruction materials available. Special 
attention was paid to the activities that facilitate the learning 
process in which you can develop your ideas and make new 
discoveries during concrete activities carried out individually 
or with peers. 
In competence-based curriculum, learning is considered as 
a process of active building and developing knowledge and 
meanings by the learner where concepts are mainly introduced 
by an activity, a situation or a scenario that helps the learner 
to construct knowledge, develop skills and acquire positive 
attitudes and values. 
For effective use of this textbook, your role is to: 
Work on given activities which lead to the development of skills;
• Share relevant information with other learners through 
presentations, discussions, group work and other active 
learning techniques such as role play, case studies, 
investigation and research in the library, from the internet 
or from your community;

• Draw conclusions based on the findings from the learning

FOREWORD 
Dear Pupil, 
Rwanda Basic Education Board is honoured to present to you 
this English book for Primary One which serves as a guide to 
competence based teaching and learning to ensure consistency 
and coherence in the learning of English subject. The Rwandan 
educational philosophy is to ensure that you achieve full potential 
at every level of education which will prepare you to be well 
integrated in society and exploit employment opportunities. 
The Government of Rwanda emphasizes the importance of 
supporting teaching and learning materials with the syllabus to 
facilitate your learning process. Many factors influence what 
you learn, how well you learn and the competences you acquire. 
Those factors include instruction materials available. Special 
attention was paid to the activities that facilitate the learning 
process in which you can develop your ideas and make new 
discoveries during concrete activities carried out individually 
or with peers. 
In competence-based curriculum, learning is considered as 
a process of active building and developing knowledge and 
meanings by the learner where concepts are mainly introduced 
by an activity, a situation or a scenario that helps the learner 
to construct knowledge, develop skills and acquire positive 
attitudes and values. 
For effective use of this textbook, your role is to: 
Work on given activities which lead to the development of skills;
• Share relevant information with other learners through 
presentations, discussions, group work and other active 
learning techniques such as role play, case studies, 
investigation and research in the library, from the internet 
or from your community;

• Draw conclusions based on the findings from the learning
activities.

i
IJAMBO RY’IBANZE
Iki gitabo k’Ikinyarwanda cy’umwaka wa mbere w’amashuri abanza  
cyanditswe bwa mbere n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze 
(REB) ku bufatanye n’Umushinga USAID Soma Umenye.  Iki gitabo 
cyavuguruwe  n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB) ku 
bufatanye n’Umushinga USAID Tunoze Gusoma, ku nkunga ya Banki y’Isi.
Iki gitabo cyanditswe hashingiwe ku byavuye mu bushakashatsi bwerekana 
uburyo bwo kwigisha gusoma no kwandika bujyanye n’integanyanyigisho 
ishingiye ku bushobozi. Twizeye tudashidikanya ko iki gitabo kizagira uruhare 
rukomeye mu kunoza imyigire n’imyigishirize yo gusoma no kwandika mu 
Kinyarwanda mu mashuri abanza.
Tuboneyeho umwanya wo gushimira abantu bose bagize uruhare mu 
ivugururwa ry’iki gitabo by’umwihariko, Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe 
za Amerika Gishinzwe Iterambere Mpuzamahanga (USAID) ku bufatanye 
gihuriyeho na Leta y’u Rwanda kibinyujije mu mushinga “USAID Tunoze 
Gusoma” na Banki y’Isi yatanze inkunga mu Rwego rw’imari. 
Twizeye nta shiti ko ubu bufatanye buzafasha abana biga mu kiciro cya mbere 
cy’amashuri abanza kumenya gusoma no kwandika ku buryo bushimishije. 
Turangije dushimira byimazeyo umurava n’ubwitange by’abakozi n’Urwego 
rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB) n’abandi bose bagize 
uruhare mu gusuzuma, gukosora, kunoza no kwemeza iki gitabo hagamijwe 
gukomeza guteza imbere ireme ry’uburezi mu Rwanda. 
Dr. MBARUSHIMANA Nelson 
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REB

GUSHIMIRA
Ndashimira mbikuye ku mutima abantu bose bagize uruhare mu ivugururwa 
ry’igitabo k’Ikinyarwanda cy’umunyeshuri, umwaka wa mbere w’amashuri 
abanza. Ntabwo iki gitabo cyashoboraga kwandikwa uko bikwiye, iyo 
hatabaho uruhare rw’abafatanyabikorwa banyuranye mu burezi.
Ndashimira abarimu bigisha mu mashuri yisumbuye n’abigisha mu mashuri 
abanza, abahanga batandukanye mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda n’abandi 
bitanze batizigamye kugira ngo iki gitabo gishobore kuvugururwa. 
Ndashimira kandi abashushanyije amashusho yakoreshejwe muri iki gitabo 
ndetse n’abagitunganyije. 
Ndanshimira nanone abakozi b’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe 
Uburezi bw’Ibanze, cyanecyane abo mu Ishami ry’Integanyanyigisho 
n’Imfashanyigisho bagize uruhare rukomeye muri uyu mushinga wo 
kuvugurura iki gitabo.
By’umwihariko, ndashimira Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika 
Gishinzwe Iterambere Mpuzamahanga (USAID) ku bufatanye gihuriyeho na 
Leta y’u Rwanda kibinyujije mu mushinga “USAIDTunoze Gusoma” inkunga 
yo mu buryo bwose cyatanze kugira ngo iki gitabo gishobore kuvugururwa.
Ndashimira byimazeyo Banki y’Isi  ku nkunga yo mu buryo bw’imari yatanze 
kugira ngo iki gitabo gishobore kuvugururwa, gucapwa no gutuburwa.
Habaye hari ubundi bwunganizi ku byanozwa muri iki gitabo twabyakira 
kugira ngo bizifashishwe mu ivugurura ry’ubutaha.
MURUNGI Joan
Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Integanyanyigisho n’Imfashanyigisho/REB

subject: Kinyarwanda
title: P1-Kinyarwanda-PB.pdf - page 9
text:
v
IRIBURIRO
Mu mpera z’umwaka wa 2022, Ishami ry’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe 
Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB), rishinzwe Gutegura Integanyanyigisho 
n’Imfashanyigisho, ryakoze isesengura ry’ibitabo by’Ikinyarwanda 
bikoreshwa guhera mu mwaka wa mbere kugeza mu mwaka wa gatatu 
w’amashuri abanza.
Icyo gikorwa cyagaragaje ibyiza bikubiye muri ibyo bitabo n’ibice bikwiye 
kunozwa, kugira ngo bifashe abanyeshuri bo mu kiciro cya mbere cy’amashuri 
abanza kwiga gusoma no kwandika mu buryo buboneye.
Ni muri urwo rwego iki gitabo cy’umunyeshuri cyanditswe hashingiwe ku 
nteganyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi, ubushakashatsi no ku buryo 
buboneye kandi bufasha abana kwiga gusoma no kwandika mu Kinyarwanda.
Ibi bizatuma abanyeshuri biyubakamo umuco wo gusoma bakiri bato. Ni 
ngombwa kandi ko ababyeyi bashishikariza abana gufata neza ibitabo byo 
gusoma.
Imyitozo iri muri iki gitabo ishingiye ku nkingi esheshatu zo kwigisha gusoma 
no kwandika nk’ishingiro ryo kwiga neza gusoma no kwandika mu buryo 
bwihuse. Izo nkingi ni itahuramajwi, ihuzamajwi, inyunguramagambo, 
gusoma udategwa no kumva umwandiko n’ururimi mvugo.
Ibikorwa byo kwandika na byo byashyizwemo nk’indi nkingi ibumbatiye 
ubushobozi abanyeshuri bakeneye mu myigire yabo.
Buri munyeshuri azahabwa igitabo. Azajya agitahana mu rugo buri munsi. 
Ibi bizamufasha gusubiramo ibyo yize mu ishuri afashijwe n’ababyeyi, 
abavandimwe, abamurera cyangwa abandi bose babana mu rugo. 
Ubushobozi bwo gusoma no kwandika bwiyongera iyo umunyeshuri abikoze 
mu gihe gihagije akaba ari yo mpamvu ari ngombwa ko abikora no mu gihe 
ari mu rugo.
Iki gitabo kirimo ibimenyetso bifasha abanyeshuri kumenya ibigomba 
gukorwa kuri buri mwitozo. Ibi bifasha umunyeshuri kwikorera umwitozo 
mu gihe adafite umwerekera ndetse no mu gihe ataramenya kwisomera 
amabwiriza.
Abanyeshuri baba abasomyi beza iyo basoma kenshi. Ni muri urwo rwego 
hateganyijwe inkuru nyinshi abanyeshuri bisomera, zanditswe hashingiwe

subject: Kinyarwanda

ku nyuguti zigomba kwigwa, kugira ngo babone umwanya uhagije wo

iv
Avant-propos
Cher élève,
Le Conseil Rwandaise de l’éducation (REB) est  honoré de présenter le livre de l’élève de la
science et de la technologie élémentaire pour la primiere année. Ce manuel est conçu pour 
soutenir la mise en œ uvre efficace du programme d'études basé sur les compétences (CBC), 
garantissant des pratiques pédagogiques centrées sur l'apprenant qui s'alignent sur la visi-
on qui correspondent  aux apprenants d’atteindre leur plein potentiel, de participer 
activement à la société et de poursuivre des carrières significatives.
Alors que le Rwanda progresse vers la construction d'une économie basée sur les connais
sances, l'éducation joue un rôle essentiel. Les enseignants sont au cœ ur de cette transform-
ation, guidant les apprenants à relier les connaissances en classe avec des expériences 
concrètes , favorisant ainsi la croissance individuelle et le développement national.
Ce manuel de l’élève consititue une ressource  complete pour l'enseignement de la science
et de la technologie élémentaire a la premiere année primaire. Cette matière fait partie 
intégrante du CBC, visant à équiper les apprenants des connaissanes, des compétences, 
des valeurs et des attitudes essentiels nécessaires pour devenir des citoyens responsables
 et compétents. Grâce à cette matière , les apprenants sont encouragés à developper des 
capacités de résolution de problèmes et à contribuer positivement à leurs communautés.
Dans le but d’assurer un éducation de qualité, le gouvernement du Rwanda souligne l'impor-
tance d'utiliser des matériels d'enseignement et d'apprentissage conformer sur le programme.
Je remercie sincèrement tous ceux qui ont contribué au raffinement de ce manuel.  La rec-
onnaissance spéciale va à l'équipe REB qui a coordonné l'ensemble du processus.  Nous 
remercions tous les partenaires, enseignants et personnes qui ont participe dans 
le processus du début jusqu’à la fin. Chaque commentaire a était très appréciée et a aidé 
à améliorer les résultats d'apprentissage du livre de l’élève.
   .
Dr Mbarushimana Nelson  
Directeur général du Conseil National de l’Education de base du Rwanda

Compétence clés des unités :
Vous pourrez identifier divers outils de ICT et leurs utilisations, et utiliser une radio et 
une télévision correctement.
À la fin de cette unité, vous devriez être en mesure de:
Objectifs d'apprentissage
À la fin de cette unité, vous devriez être en mesure de:
Connaissance et compréhension
 • Nommez différents outils ICT (comme la radio, la télévision, 
le téléphone).  
• Dites à quoi chaque outil ICT est utilisé.
Compétences
 • Allumez et désactivez les outils ICT comme la télévision et la radio.
 • Montrez comment utiliser une radio en modifiant les stations 
 • Montrez comment activer un téléviseur et changer de chaîne.
Attitudes et valeurs
 • Prenez soin des outils ICT telsque la télévision, la radio et 
les haut-parleurs.  
• Afficher l'intérêt à apprendre à utiliser un téléphone, une radio 
et une télévision.  
• Posez des questions pour savoir d'où viennent le son et les images.

Activité 6.3.3
Importance de brosser des dents
Se brosser des dents est important parce que:
 • Cela élimine les particules alimentaires.
 • Cela rend les dents solides et saines.  
• Cela aide à garder la bouche propre et à arrêter une mauvaise odeur dans la bouche.  
 • Les dents propres permetent de sourire en toute confiance.
Quand se brosser les dents?
Brossez vous les dents deux fois par jour et tous les jours: matin après le petit déjeuner et 
le soir avant le coucher.

Se brosser les dents avec une brosse à dents, du dentifrice fluoré et  eau propre
sur une brosse à dents .
Étapes pour brosser les dents
1 ère Etape: Metter 2 cm de dentifrice fluoré de sur une brosse à dents douce souple. 
2  ème Etape: Brosser l'avant, le dessus et le sessous de chaque dent. 
3 ème Etape: Brosser la langue délicatement. 
4 ème Etape:: Crasher mais ne pas rincer, gardez un peu de fluoré sur les dents. 
Remarque: Il n'est pas bon de manger et de boire des aliments et des boissons avec  
riche en fluore, nottament le gateau, les biscuits, les soda et les juit sucre. Le sucre 
attaquent les dents.

Le  Conseil  rwandais  de  l'éducation  de  base  (REB)  a  l'honneur  de  présenter  le  Manuel 
de  l'élève  de  sciences  et  de  technologie  élémentaire  pour  le  CE1.  Ce  manuel  est  conçu 
pour  soutenir  la  mise  en  œuvre  efficace  du  Programme  d'enseignement  par 
compétences  (PEC),  garantissant
des  pratiques  pédagogiques  centrées  sur  l'élève,  conformes  à  la  vision  du  Rwanda:
donner  aux  élèves  les  moyens  d'atteindre  leur  plein  potentiel,  de  participer  activement
à  la  société  et  de  poursuivre  des  carrières  enrichissantes.
Alors  que  le  Rwanda  progresse  vers  une  économie  du  savoir,  l'éducation  joue  un  rôle 
essentiel.  Les  enseignants  sont  au  cœur  de  cette  transformation,  guidant  les  élèves  à 
relier  les  connaissances  acquises  en  classe  à  des  expériences  concrètes,  favorisant 
ainsi  l'épanouissement  individuel  et  le  développement  national.
Ce  livre  de  l'élève  constitue  une  ressource  complète  pour  l'enseignement  des  sciences 
et  de  la  technologie  élémentaire  en  CE1.  Cette  matière  fait  partie  intégrante  du  CBC  et
vise  à  doter  les  élèves  des  connaissances,  compétences,  valeurs  et  attitudes
essentielles
pour  devenir  des  citoyens  responsables  et  compétents.  Grâce  à  cette  matière,  les 
élèves  sont  encouragés  à  développer  leur  capacité  à  résoudre  des  problèmes  et  à 
contribuer  positivement  à  la  vie  de  leur  communauté.
Dans  la  poursuite  d’une éducation  de  qualité,  le  gouvernement  du  Rwanda  souligne 
l’importance d’utiliser des  matériels  d’enseignement et  d’apprentissage alignés  sur  le 
programme  scolaire.
Je  remercie  sincèrement  tous  ceux  qui  ont  contribué  à  l'amélioration  de  ce  manuel.

J'ai  appris  que :
Certains  matériaux  utilisés  pour  fabriquer  des  avions  jouets  proviennent  de  notre 
communauté :  bouteilles  en  plastique  vides,  carton,  clous,  couteaux,  etc.
Les  étapes  de  fabrication  d'un  avion  jouet  comprennent :
1.Préparez  le  biberonen  retirant  les  étiquettes  et  en  nettoyant  la  bouteille.
2.Couper  les  ailes :Découpez  deux  ailes  rectangulaires  (10  à  15  cm  de  long)  dans  du  carton  
ou  de  la  mousse.
  Arrondissez  les  bords  pour  leur  donner  la  forme  de  l'aile.
3.Attachez  les  ailesDécoupez  des  fentes  horizontales  de  chaque  côté  de  la  bouteille
  (partie  médiane).  Glissez  les  ailes  dans  les  fentes  et  fixez-les  avec  de  la  colle.
4.Créer  une  section  de  queueDécoupez  un  stabilisateur  vertical  (aileron  arrière)  et  un  
stabilisateur
  horizontal  (aileron  arrière)  dans  du  carton.  Collez-les  à  l'arrière  de  la  bouteille.
5.Fabriquer  l'héliceDécoupez  une  forme  d'hélice  dans  du  carton  ou  utilisez  un  bouchon  de
  bouteille.  Percez  un  trou  au  centre.  Enfilez  une  brochette  ou  une  paille  dans  la  perle  et
  l'hélice,  puis  fixez-la  sur  le  devant  de  la  bouteille  avec  de  la  colle.
6.Décorer:  Peignez  la  bouteille  ou  utilisez  des  marqueurs  pour  ajouter  des  détails  (fenêtres,  
logos,  etc.).

text:
IJAMBO RY’IBANZE
Munyeshuri,
Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze runejejwe no kukugezaho igitabo 
k’Ikinyarwanda, umwaka wa kane w’amashuri abanza. Iki gitabo cyateguwe hagamijwe 
gushyira mu bikorwa Integanyanyigisho Ishingiye ku Bushobozi (CBC) kugira ngo uhabwe 
uruhare mu myigire yawe. Ibyo bigamije kugutegurira gukomeza kwiga amashuri yawe 
kugira ngo wunguke ubumenyi, ubumenyi ngiro n’ubukesha bizagufasha kwihangira 
umurimo no kuba Umunyarwanda mwiza. Mu kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi, Leta y’u Rwanda 
ishyira imbaraga mu gutegura imfashanyigisho zijyanye n’integanyanyigisho kugira ngo 
zizagufashe mu myigire yawe. 
Nk’uko u Rwanda rukomeje kwiyubaka rugana ku bukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi, uburezi 
ni inkingi ya mwamba muri urwo rugendo rwo kwiyubaka. Abarimu bazagira uruhare mu 
kukuyobora ku bumenyi bujyanye n’ubuzima busanzwe bwa buri munsi. Ibyo bizagufasha 
kwiteza imbere no guteza imbere Igihugu muri rusange.
Iki gitabo cy’umunyeshuri ni imfashanyigisho nziza izagufasha kwiga neza isomo 
ry’ Ikinyarwanda mu mwaka wa kane w’amashuri abanza. Iri somo ni ingenzi mu gushyira 
mu bikorwa Integanyanyigisho Ishingiye ku Bushobozi kuko rizatanga ubumenyi, ubumenyi 
ngiro n’ubukesha bikenewe kugira ngo uzabe umuturage ushoboye kandi w’inyangamugayo. 
Uzagira ubushobozi mu kwikemurira ibibazo no guhanga udushya dukenewe mu muryango 
mugari. 
Ndashimira byimazeyo buri wese wagize uruhare mu kwandika no mu kunoza iki gitabo. 
Ndashimira by’umwihariko itsinda rya REB ryayoboye iki gikorwa kuva kigitangira kugeza 
kirangiye. Turashimira kandi abafatanyabikorwa bose, abarimu n’abandi bose bagize 
uruhare muri uru rugendo.  Ibitekerezo byanyu birakenewe mu gukomeza kunoza iki gitabo 
kugira ngo imyigire y’abanyeshuri bacu irusheho kuba myiza.
Dr. MBARUSHIMANA Nelson
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REB

0.1. Umwandiko: Mpyisi na Mpwerume
Igikorwa cya 1:  Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza.
Mpyisi na Mpwerume
Umunsi umwe amapfa yarateye, 
inyamamaswa nyinshi zicwa n’inzara. 
Mpyisi, aho yiberaga mu isenga ye, 
yigira inama yo kujya gusaba akazi 
kwa Ntare, umwami w’ishyamba. 
Ahata inzira ibirenge, agezeyo asanga 
Ntare ari gukarabywa n’abagaragu 
be. Aravunyisha, baramwakira, 
baramuzimanira. Atekerereza Ntare 
ibibazo bye. 
Mpyisi amaze kumvwa na Ntare, amuha akazi ko gusya, anamurangira aho azajya akopwa 
ibiribwa. Yamusabye kandi kuzamushakira undi musyi w’umuhanga. 
Ubwo Mpyisi yaratashye, ajya gushaka insyo. Mu nzira, ahura n’inshuti ye Mpwerume. 
Nuko  Mpwerume abwira Mpyisi   ko afite ikibazo cyo kurembywa n’inzara no kuba wenyine 
mu kibuti.  Mpyisi abwira Mpwerume ati: “Reka dushake insyo, dufatanye kuzigeza kwa 
Ntare, nituzigezayo Ntare araguha akazi”. Nuko bashaka insyo, barazikorera bazijyana 
kwa ntare.
Bageze ku irembo bumva Ntare arimo gutontoma maze baba baretse kwinjira. Ntare ngo 
yari arambiwe guhombywa n’abana b’inkende ndetse n’inyoni. Abana b’inkende bari biraye 
mu murima we w’ibigori barabirya barabimara. Inyoni na zo zirirwaga ziririmbira mu byari 
byazo, zidakora ahubwo zikona amasaka ye. Ntare amaze gucururuka, Mpyisi na Mpwerume 
binjira mu rugo n’insyo. Mpyisi abwira Ntare ko amuzaniye umusyi w’umuhanga. Ntare 
arishima, abasaba gutangira akazi. 
Mpyisi akorana umurava akazi yahawe, Ntare aramushimira maze ahita amuha n’inshingano 
yo gucunga ikigega k’inzoga. Mpwerume yegera Mpyisi ati: “Nshuti yange ntugire ngo ni 
ishyari ribinteye. Nabonye kariya kazi utazagashobora kubera ubusambo bwawe.” Mpyisi 
yumvise amagambo ya Mpwerume arababara cyane ariko hashize iminsi mike, kwihishira 
biranga, yadukana ingeso ye y’ubusambo. Inzoga bamusigiye zo kuzimanira abashyitsi 
arazinywera arazimara.

0.3. Umwandiko: Imyuga irakiza
Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
Imyuga irakiza
Imyuga gakondo ni imwe mu mirimo 
yari itunze abantu bo mu Rwanda rwo 
hambere. Yari ifatiye runini Abanyarwanda 
bayikoraga. Wasangaga ibikoresho gakondo 
byakorwaga byihariye. Byabaga bikoranye 
ubuhanga buhanitse. Aho iyo myuga 
ikigaragara uyu munsi usanga ifasha abantu 
kwikura mu bukene. 
Umuryango wa Ncyuyinka wari ukennye, 
utunzwe no gusabiriza. Bambaraga 
inshabari, abana batiga. Rubanda 
birirwaga babaha urw’amenyo kubera 
ubukene bwabo. 
Umunsi umwe, Ncyuyinka n’umugore we baricaye baraganira, bigira inama yo gushaka 
imyuga bakora kugira ngo ntibazongere gusumbywa ubukungu n’abaturanyi babo.  
Ncyuyinka atangira kujya aramvura ingoma mu biti, akazirema, abakaraza baza 
kuzikosha bakamwishyura amafaranga. Umugore we Nyiranshywa we yahisemo gukora 
umwuga w’ububoshyi bw’ibiseke bikarumywaho imitemeri yabyo bityo ibintu bibitswemo 
ntibyangirike. Abo babyeyi batoje abana babo Sano na Mutoni iyo myuga. Sano aboha 
uduseke dushimishije naho Mutoni agafatanya na se kuramvura ingoma.  Mwishywa wa 
Ncyuyinka yaje kubasura maze anezezwa n’imyuga babyara be bakora, yiyemeza na we 
kuzayiga.
Imyuga yatumye umuryango wa Ncyuyinka wikungahaza, bityo abana babo babasha kujya 
mu ishuri none ubu biga neza. Mu gihe k’ibiruhuko bafasha ababyeyi mu myuga yabo. 
Ingoma baramvura zikoshwa amafaranga menshi agafasha abayeyi babo kubagurira 
ibikoresho by’ishuri. Uduseke na two turagurishwa maze amafaranga avuyemo agakenura 
urugo rwabo.
Umwuga w’ububoshyi n’uwo kuramvura ingoma yateje imbere umuryango wa Ncyuyinka 
ntiwongera kurembywa n’inzara maze bibarinda incyuro z’ababakwenaga kubera ubukene. 
None ubu umuryango wa Ncyuyinka wubashywe na buri wese.

Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
Ubunyangamugayo bwa Mfwati
Mfwati ni umwana wa Mpyorero na 
Ncyurinkwano. Batuye i Buhovwabuki. 
Mfwati arangwa no kumvira inama z’ababyeyi 
n’abarezi kandi areba kure ku buryo 
ataryarywa mu buryo bworoshye.
Umunsi umwe, mu rugo iwabo haje 
abashyitsi. Se amutuma kugura umusururu 
wo kubazimanira. Yamuhaye inoti y’igihumbi 
maze agenda yiruka ajya kwa Ndwaniye 
ucuruza umusururu. 
Agura amacupa ane y’umusururu yishyura 
amafaranga igihumbi.
Ndwaniye amugarurira amafaranga menshi nuko Mfwati, n’ikinyabupfura kinshi aravuga 
ati: “Mubyeyi, muribeshye mungarurira amafaranga menshi. Munsubije igihumbi na magana 
atandatu aho kumpa magana atandatu!”  Ndwaniye atangazwa n’ubunyangamugayo 
ndetse n’ubupfura by’uwo mwana.  Nuko amuhemba icupa ry’ubuki, rishushanyijeho indabo 
zihovwamo n’inzuki rigaragaraho n’inzuki zahovye ubuki. Mfwati arishima, ataha yihuta.
Igihe yari hafi kugera mu rugo, Mfwati atoragura inoti ya bitanu. Ageze mu rugo abwira 
mushiki we Ncyuyinyana ko atoraguye amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu. Mushiki we yitera hejuru 
n’ibyishimo maze aramubwira ati: “Urangurira bombo n’amandazi!”. Mfwati amusubizanya 
ubwitonzi agira ati: “Ndabanza nshake uwayataye, nimubura mbone kuyakoresha.” 
Mfwati yasohotse hanze, ako kanya abona Sano yahomvomvye kandi anarira. 
Yahomvomvywaga no kuba yataye amafaranga. Aramwegera amubaza ikimuriza. Sano 
aramusubiza ati: “Mama yantumye isukari, ngiye kwishyura amafaranga ndayabura, 
nyoberwa aho nyataye.” Mfwati aramubaza ati: “Ufite ibimenyetso by’ayo mafaranga 
ku buryo tubonye uwayatoye wayamenya?” Sano aramusubiza ati: “Ni inoti ipfunyaritse 
kubera ko bayimeseye mu myenda.” Mfwati aramubwira ati: “Shyira umutima hamwe, 
ayo mafaranga nayatoye.” Mfwati amuhereza inoti ye maze Sano arishima, aramuhobera 
cyane, aramubwira ati: “Ninkura nzakugororera.” Ahita ajya kugura isukari, maze arataha.

1.1. Umwandiko: Umurage w’abavandimwe batatu
Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza.
Umurage w’abavandimwe batatu
Habayeho umugabo akagira abana batatu, 
abahungu babiri n’umukobwa umwe. Uwo 
mugabo nta bintu yagiraga, uretse inzu yari 
atuyemo i Bwanacyambwe. Buri mwana 
yifuzaga kuzaragwa iyo nzu. 
Umunsi umwe ari ku wa Gatanu mu kwezi 
k’Ukuboza, wa mugabo ageze mu za 
bukuru, aribaza ati: 
“Inzu yange nzayiraga nde?” Yigira inama yo kugerageza abana be kugira ngo uzarusha 
abandi ubutwari, azabe ari we uyegukana. Nuko arabahamagara, arababwira ati: “Bana 
bange, kuva ubu, ndashaka ko mugenda, mukajya kwirwanaho, buri wese akiga umwuga. 
Nimugaruka, uzaba yararushije abandi kumenya neza umwuga we, ni we nzaraga inzu yange 
pe!” Abana bose barabyemera maze basezerana umunsi bazagarukiraho. Umwe aca ukwe, 
undi ukwe. Buri wese agenda afite umugambi wo kuzaragwa inzu ya se.
Umwana w’imfura Karangwa yiga gucura aba umucuzi. Uw’ubuheta Mukamwezi yiga 
kogosha, aba umwogoshi. Uwa gatatu Gasangwa yiga kurasa, aba umusirikari. Imyuga yabo 
bose bayikoraga neza cyane. Buri wese yaribwiraga ati: “Nizeye ko inzu ya data ari nge 
uzayisigarana kuko nzi neza umwuga wange.”

Umunsi wo gutaha ugeze, bose baratashye, bahurira kwa se kugira ngo berekane ubuhanga 
bwabo. Ibyo byahuriranye n’uko mu gihugu cyabo hari hateganyijwe irushanwa rikomeye 
ryerekeye imyuga. Umwami yari yaratumije abahanga mu kogosha, mu kumasha, mu gucura 
n’ibindi.
Nuko ba bana bitabira ayo marushanwa. Hatangira abogoshi, barogosha, barogosha karahava! 
Abantu benshi bahururira wa mukobwa, batangarira ubuhanga bwe kubera ko yogoshaga 
vuba kandi neza. Abo yogoshaga yabakiranaga urugwiro kandi akabogosha abaganiriza. 
Abogoshi barangije, hakurikiraho abacuzi. Abacuzi bategekwa gucura ishusho y’umwami. 
Inyundo barazibaha, batangira gucura. Igihe abandi bagihuzagurika, icyuya cyabarenze, wa 
musore wize ibyo gucura, ishusho aba ayishyize aho. Rubanda barashika n’abarushanwaga, 
inyundo barazinaga, bahururira ya shusho kuko yasaga neza n’umwami.
Hakurikiyeho abamasha. Na bo bagombaga guhamya intobo itunze ku gisongo gishinze mu 
ntambwe magana abiri. Abantu benshi barahakuranwa barasa, habura n’umwe uhamya 
intobo. Maze wa muhungu w’umusirikare azana ubuhanga bwe, araforaaa…ngo pya! 
Umwambi ugurukana ya ntobo, abantu bose bariyamira.
Nuko ba bavandimwe uko ari batatu batsinda amarushanwa, baragororerwa. Kubera ko buri 
mwana yari yerekanye ubuhanga bwe butangaje mu mwuga we, se yabaraze ya nzu uko ari 
batatu, iba umutungo wabo bafatanyije.
Umubyeyi wabo yaje gupfa, ba bana bakomeza gukora imyuga yabo, biteza imbere, baba

Ubwikorezi mu iterambere 
Buri munsi, abantu baba bakeneye kugenda no gutwara ibintu. Babikora kugira ngo babone 
ibyo bakeneye, bagurishe ibyo bafite cyangwa basure abandi. Kugenda bikorwa mu buryo 
butandukanye haba ku butaka, mu mazi cyangwa mu kirere.

Itumanaho
Itumanaho ni uburyo abantu bakoresha kugira ngo bagezanyeho amakuru, aho bari hose 
kandi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Ari abana, ari abakuze, bose bakenera itumanaho.  Ribafasha 
kumenya ibibera hirya no hino ku isi no gukora neza imirimo yabo ya buri munsi. Abantu 
barikenera mu bucuruzi, mu burezi, mu buvuzi, mu buhinzi no mu mitangire ya serivisi 
zitandukanye.
Itumanaho rikorwa mu buryo bwinshi. Abantu bashobora kuvugana mu magambo cyangwa 
kwandikirana amabaruwa. Bashobora kandi gukoresha ibitangazamakuru bikoresha amajwi 
n’amashusho nka radiyo na tereviziyo. Abantu banakoresha cyane terefoni na murandasi. 
Radiyo na tereviziyo bigeza amakuru ku bantu benshi. Ibinyamakuru byandika byo 
ntibikunda gukoreshwa cyane kuko abantu bamwe ntibamenyereye kandi ntibakunda

Inzozi za Nkundabantu
Nkundabantu yari umunyeshuri wo mu Karere ka Bugesera, uzwiho kugira ibitekerezo 
bigari ku iterambere. Yakundaga kwibaza impamvu bamwe babaho neza abandi bakabaho 
nabi, akumva yifuza kuzagira uruhare mu guhindura ibyo abona.
Mu buzima bwa buri munsi, yabonaga ibibazo byinshi. Yabonaga abana bata ishuri, 
abaturage badafata isuku nk’ikintu k’ingenzi, abaturage badakunda gukora, abantu 
badakunda gufasha abakecuru n’abasaza, batita ku mfubyi n’abapfakazi n’ibindi. Ibyo 
byatumaga agira umwete wo guharanira kwita kuri ibyo bibazo. 
Nkundabantu ntiyabonaga ibibazo gusa, yabonaga n’ibikorwa byiza by’abantu binyuranye. 
Yabonaga abaturage bamwe batangiye guhinga kijyambere, akabona abakoresha 
ikoranabuhanga mu bucuruzi, abakoresha ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n’ibindi. Ibyo 
byatumaga abona ko impinduka zishoboka. 
Umunsi umwe, umwarimu wabo yabasabye kuvuga uruhare rwabo mu iterambere ry’Igihugu. 
Nkundabantu asubiza ko gukunda Igihugu, kugira ubumwe, gukunda umurimo no kugira

2.1. Umwandiko: Ibintu ni magirirane
Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza.
Ibintu ni magirirane
Noza iyi shusho abana babe bagaragara neza bariya wagira ngo nta maso bafite. 
Iyo abantu babonye umuntu agiriye neza uwigeze na we kuyimugirira, nibwo bavuga ngo: 
«Ibintu ni magirirane ». Wakomotse kuri Sebantu mwene Ruhago wari utuye ku Ndiza 
akaba umupfumu n’umunyanzoga wa Mashira ya Nkuba ya Sabugabo, umwami w’i Nduga. 
Yarangwaga n’imico myiza ku buryo abenshi bazaga kumuhanuza nta kiguzi yabakaga, 
abamusabye inzoga bafite inyota, ntabagurishe akabahera ubuntu.
Umunsi umwe, Mashira n’abapfumu be bagiye kuragura, baraguriza kureba niba Sekarongoro 
wari umwami w’u Rwanda icyo gihe, atazanyaga Mashira Nduga na Ndiza. Abapfumu ba 
Mashira babona mu ndagu ko Sekarongoro nta cyo azatwara Mashira ariko Sebantu na 
Mashira barashidikanya. Nuko na bo bararagura bahinyuza maze babona Nduga na Ndiza 
Sekarongoro azabitwara. 
Sebantu amaze kumenya ko Mashira azatsindwa ahita amucika yisangira Mibambwe. 
Mibambwe abonye umuntu uvuye kwa Mashira arishima cyane, aramutonesha cyane, 
amushyira mu bandi bapfumu b’ibwami. Amaze kwakirwa ababwira uko indagu zo kwa 
Mashira zagenze bituma Mibambwe arushaho kwishima.
Haciyeho iminsi, Mibambwe atera Mashira.  Sebantu ajya imbere y’ingabo, batera Mashira 
ku Kivumu. Ingabo za Mashira ziraneshwa, Mashira arafatwa bamushyira Mibambwe. Ageze 
imbere ye, abantu benshi bemeza ko Mashira akwiye gupfa. Sebantu wahoze ari umugaragu 
yibuka aho yamuvanye ari umukene cyane, yiyemeza kumusabira imbabazi kuri Mibambwe. 
Na we aramukundira aramurekura, anamushyira mu bandi bapfumu b’ibwami hamwe na 
mwishywa we Munyanya. Sebantu na we aguma kuba umutoni kuri Mibambwe ndetse 
agabana Ndiza, kimwe mu bihugu Mashira yategekaga.
Nyuma y’iminsi myinshi, Sebantu ajyana inka zo gukura ubwatsi kwa Mibambwe arashimwa. 
Abonye ashimwe, aboneraho asabira Mashira kudohorerwa. Mibambwe aremera aha 
Mashira inka.

Akamaro k’umuganda kagaragarira buri wese kuko hari ibikorwa byinshi byagezweho kubera 
wo. Aha twavuga nko guharura imihanda, gutera amashyamba, gusukura aho dutuye n’ibindi.
Ku wa Gatandatu ushize, abaturage bo mu Mudugudu wa Kinkware bahujwe no kubaka 
ishuri ry’inshuke abana babo bazajya bigiramo. Nyuma y’umuganda abo baturage bicaye 
hamwe bungurana ibitekerezo ku ngingo y’ubumwe bw’ Abanyarwanda.
Umuyobozi w’umudugudu yabwiye abaturage ko kuva kera, Abanyarwanda barangwaga 
n’ubumwe. Yongeyeho ko ubumwe bw’ Abanyarwanda ari umuco karande waranze 
abasokuruza bacu. Yabivuze agira ati: “Abasokuruza bacu barangwaga no gutabarana, 
gutumirana, guhana inka, kuremera abatishoboye, kohererezanya intashyo, kugemurirana 
no guhana  umuganda. Bahingiraga hamwe mu budehe ndetse bagatabarira hamwe 
Igihugu cyatewe.”
Umuyobozi w’Umudugudu yakomeje yibutsa abaturage ko ubumwe buhera mu muryango. 
Nuko aravuga ati: “Ubumwe rero buhera iwacu mu rugo. Mu miryango yacu tugomba 
kurangwa no gukorera hamwe. Umugore, umugabo n’abana bagomba gufatanya bagakorera 
hamwe kugira ngo urugo rwabo rugwize ibirutunga.”
Umuyobozi yageze aho aha ijambo abaturage kugira ngo bungurane ibitekerezo ku nkingi 
z’ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda.
Karima, umwarimu wo muri kaminuza yunganira umuyobozi agira ati: “Ubumwe 
bw’Abanyarwanda ni inkingi ya mwamba iterambere rishingiyeho. Guhuza ingufu zacu, 
tukirinda kuba ba nyamwigendaho ni byo bizimakaza ubumwe bwacu n’iterambere tumaze 
kugeraho. Ni indangagaciro tugomba kubungabunga.”
Tuyishime umujyanama w’ubuzima atanga igitekerezo agira ati: “Kuba duhuriye ku rurimi 
rumwe rw’Ikinyarwanda, tugahuzwa n’umuco umwe ni amahirwe atuma ubumwe bwacu 
busigasirwa. Gushyira hamwe ni byo bituma iterambere ryihuta, Igihugu cyacu kigakataza 
mu majyambere.” Ubwisungane mu kwivuza ni imwe muri gahunda zifasha kwimakaza 
ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda kuko igamije ubuzima buzira umuze bw’abaturage. 
Nyuma y’ibitekerezo by’abaturage banyuranye, umuyobozi w’umudugudu yasoje inama 
agira ati: “Baturage b’umudugudu wacu ndabashimiye kandi ndabasaba gukomeza ubumwe 
bwanyu. Ubwo bumwe bugaragarira mu migenzo myiza nko gutabarana no gutwerera 
uwagize ubukwe cyangwa ibirori. Bugaragarira kandi mu guheka umurwayi mumujyana 
kwa muganga mugenda mwakuranwa mu mujishi, m u  kugemurira umurwayi kwa 
muganga n’ibindi. Ibyo byose ni umuco nyarwanda ugaragaza ubumwe bwacu.” Yarangije 
agira ati: “Abishyize hamwe ntakibananira.”

Hanyurwimfura: Murekatete, ko numva kuri radiyo bakunda kuvuga ngo “Dufashe 
abatishoboye”, wandusha kumenya abatishoboye abo ari bo?
Murekatete: Mbega ikibazo kiza! Abatishoboye ni abantu batabasha kubona ibyo 
bakeneye kugira ngo babeho. Urugero: ni abana batagira kivurira, 
abantu bafite ubumuga, abasaza n’abakecuru, abarwayi barembye, 
abakene cyane, impunzi cyangwa abadafite akazi. Bose bakeneye 
ubufasha kugira ngo babone ibyo bakeneye nk’ibiryo, aho kuba 
n’ubuvuzi.
Hanyurwimfura: Ese igikorwa cyo kwita ku batishoboye kiba giteye gite?
Murekatete: Ni igikorwa gikozwe ku bushake, kigamije gufasha. Ingero harimo 
kubakorera ubuvugizi, kubaha ibyo bakeneye, kubavuza, kububakira 
cyangwa kubambika. Ni no kubatega amatwi, kubasura, no kubashakira 
ibisubizo by’ibibazo bafite. Benshi bashobora no gufashwa kwiteza 
imbere binyuze mu matsinda cyangwa kubabonera ubwisungane mu 
kwivuza.
Hanyurwimfura: Ese buri wese ashobora kugira icyo afasha?
Murekatete: Yego rwose! N’udafite byinshi ashobora gukora byinshi nko gusana 
inzu y’umukecuru, guha umwana ibikoresho by’ishuri, gusura 
umurwayi cyangwa se gushishikariza abandi kubafasha. Abana na 
bo bashobora kugira uruhare binyuze mu gukangurira abandi gukora 
ibyiza.
Hanyurwimfura: Aho dusengera batubwiye ko nitujya tunyura ku muntu ukuze atwaye 
ikintu tuzajya tumutwaza. Ese ibyo na byo ni ugufasha abatishoboye?
Murekatete: Yego rwose! Urwo ni urugero rwiza rwo gufasha abatishoboye. Kwita 
ku batishoboye ni ukubereka urukundo n’impuhwe. Ni ukubafasha 
uko ushoboye, ukabaha agaciro, ukirinda kubasuzugura. Kuba 
batishoboye si uko babyifuje, ni yo mpamvu tugomba kubitaho.
Hanyurwimfura: Mbega byiza! Koko babivuze ukuri ngo: “Ubwenge burarahurwa” . 
Urakoze cyane kunsobanurira. Ubu nange ngiye kujya nita ku 
batishoboye kandi mbikangurire bagenzi bange.

Isuzuma risoza umutwe wa kabiri
Soma umwandiko ukurikira maze usubize ibibazo byawubajijweho: 
Inkokokazi n’imbata
Kera hariho ishyamba ryari rituwe n’amoko menshi y’inyamaswa. Muri iryo shyamba 
habagamo imbata n’inkokokazi byari inshuti zidasanzwe. Umubano wazo wari intangarugero. 
Zasangiraga byose, zaruhukiraga hamwe ku manywa ndetse zikarara zibyigana ku ishami 
rimwe ry’igiti cyari kizwi ku izina rya “Agahuriro k’inshuti.”
Inkokokazi yari izwiho ubwenge n’ubwitange, imbata yo ikaba ikitegererezo mu rukundo 
no gukunda amazi. Iminsi yasimburanaga ari myiza, uko bukeye n’uko bwije, bigasangira 
udufi, imbuto z’ishyamba ndetse bikanasabana n’utundi tunyamaswa two mu ishyamba.
Umunsi umwe haje kuba ikiza. Imbata yagiye koga mu ruzi ruri ku nkombe y’ishyamba 
nk’uko byari bisanzwe. Icyo gihe amazi yari yabaye menshi cyane kubera imvura yari imaze 
iminsi igwa. Imbata ntiyari izi ko ibintu byahindutse. Yibiye mu mazi izi ko ari ayo isanzwe 
imenyereye. Nuko   amazi ayibana menshi, iroga, irogaaaa… igeze aho irananirwa, ifatwa 
ku byatsi byo ku nkombe inanirwa kuhava.
Izindi nyamaswa zari zihari zarabibonye maze zihutira kubimenyesha inkokokazi. Nubwo 
imbata yari kure, ntibyabujije inkokokazi guhaguruka itazuyaje maze yiruka ijya gushaka 
imbata. Yageze ku ruzi, isanga imbata yafashe mu byatsi byo ku nkombe. Nuko inkokokazi 
iyikurura buhorobuhoro iyigeza ku butaka.
Inkoko yabonye ko inshuti yayo itagifite imbaraga, ihita ifata umwanzuro wo kurarira 
amagi yayo. Yari inkokokazi imaze gutera amagi ane, imbata na yo yari yarateye atandatu 
mbere yo kurengerwa n’amazi.  Inkokokazi yarayarariye maze iyaturaga yose uko yari 
icumi, hasohoka imishwi myiza, itandukanye mu mabara. 
Ya mishwi icumi yose yakuranye urukundo n’ubwumvikane budasanzwe. Ntiyigeze yumva

Mushiki we ati: “Baruka rutare, Baba yinjire!” Urutare rukabaruka. Baba akazana utunyoni 
bakaduteka, umukobwa yaba afite agafu, akarika, bakarya. Bwacya mu gitondo, mu 
bunyoni, musaza we akabaduka agasubira guhiga utunyamaswa.
Nyuma y’igihe, ikinyamaswa kitwa Kizimu, kimeze nk’impyisi cyumviriza ibyo Baba avuga 
aririmba.  Nuko umunsi umwe kigerageza kumwigana. Wa mukobwa amenya ko atari ijwi 
rya musaza we aricecekera. Cya gisimba kiragenda ariko ntibyatinda kiza gushobora 
kwigana Baba, urutare rurakinguka. 
Nyanshya abona igipyisi kiraje ati: “Ye data we! Sogokuru ngukarangire utuyuzi tw’impaza? 
Igipyisi kiti: “Yego mukaka wange.”
Wa mukobwa afata akungo, akaranga utuyuzi. Nuko abwira cya gisimba, ati: “Rero 
sogokuru, urutaruka rujya hanze, ni urwawe, urujya mu mbere ni urwange, urujya ku rutara 
ni urwa musaza wange.” Kizimu kiti: “Ndabyemeye.” Nuko akaranga za nzuzi. Uruyuzi 
rumwe rurataruka, rujya hanze. Nyanshya ati: “Ngurwo urwawe ruragiye.” Cya gisimba 
kiruka kijya hanze. Urutare rurafatana. Cya gisimba kiragenda, umukobwa aguma aho.
Musaza we aza kuza nimugoroba, yongera guhamagara mushiki we uko asanzwe abigenza. 
Undi araceceka, agira ngo ni cya gisimba kije. Musaza we arongera arahamagara, mushiki 
we yumva ari we. Abwira urutare rurakinguka, Baba arinjira, asanga yagize ubwoba. 
Amutekerereza uko igisimba cyamwinjiranye kigize Baba n’amayeri yakoresheje kugira ngo 
kigende. 
Musaza we yirirwa aho n’icumu n’umuhoro azi ko kigaruka ngo akice ariko nticyagaruka. 
Ategereza iminsi itatu nticyaza. Inzara ibishe, asubira guhiga.
Cya gisimba cyamenye ko Baba yagiye kiragaruka kiramwigana. Nyanshya agira ngo ni 
musaza we, abwira urutare rurakinguka. Agiye kubona, abona hinjiye cya gipyisi, kiramurya.
Musaza we atashye, arahamagara abura umwitaba. Abwira urutare rurakinguka. Arebye 
mu rusenge rw’urutare, abona imyenda mushiki we yari yambaye ariko we aramubura. 
Bukeye Baba ajya gushaka cya gipyisi ngo ahorere mushiki we, arakibona. Agiye kukica, 
kiti: “Ca aka gatoki ukuremo mushiki wawe nariye. Baba abigenza atyo, akuramo mushiki 
we. Agitera icumu arakica. Anyaga ibyacyo byose, nuko atahana ibyishimo.
Si nge wahera; hahera Kizimu.

Igikorwa cya 1. Gusoma umwandiko

Inshuti y’ibihe byose
Imparage ishaje yari imaze igihe yararembye 
yarabuze n’icyayijyana kwa muganga. 
Abavandimwe ndetse n’abana bayo bose 
bari batuye kure cyane.
Umunsi umwe, impara ijya kuyisura, isanga 
yararembye cyane iyigirira impuhwe.

cyane itangira kuyishakira icyo yatamira.
Imparage yakomeje kuremba impara ifata 
umwanzuro wo kuyijyana kwa muganga. 
Yagerageje gushaka ivuriro hafi y’aho 
imparage yari ituye ariko iraribura. 
Bukeye ifata umwanzuro wo kujya kuyivuza ku kandi gasozi. Burya koko babivuze ukuri 
ko inshuti nyanshuti uyibona mu byago. Ako gasozi kabagaho intare y’inkazi nyamara 
impara irihara maze iheka imparage iyijyanayo. Impara iyigejeje kwa muganga ivurwa 
neza, irakira. Abaganga barazisezerera maze zihita zitaha. Nuko zisubira mu rugo zifite 
umunezero mwinshi.

Igikorwa cya 1. Gusoma imyandiko

Twisekere
1. Umugabo ufite inda nini yahuye 
n’ufite uruhara. Nuko ufite inda ninini 
ashaka kwishongora k’ufite uruhara 
aramubaza ati: “Mbe shahu ko 
wikoreye ikibuga uyu munsi amakipe 
yagombaga guhura arakinira 
he?” Nuko nyiri uruhara na we 
ntiyazuyaza amwereka ko atameze 
urw’ubusa maze aramusubiza ati: 
“None se ko nabonaga umupira 
wawumize, nashatse kugukurikiza 
ikibuga kugira ngo nuwusohora 
bahite bakina.”
   
2. Umunsi umwe intama yagendanaga n’ihene maze ihene icyaha intama iti: “Kuki uhora 
ujunjamye ucuritse umutwe?” Intama irayisubiza iti: “Mba nanga kukureba wambaye 
ubusa nta kariso wambaye.” Ihene  yahise izunguza umutwe iriruka. Kariharya 
n’umugore we bari aho baraseka barakumbagara.
3. Imbwa yagiye kwiba mu rugo rw’umukungu ikacira inyama iriruka. Umukobwa 
w’uwo mukungu aba yayibonye ayirukaho. Imukebutse  iribwira, iti: «Dore icyo 
nkundira abakungu, ujyayo bakaguha inyama kandi bakaguherekeza! »
4. Umunyeshuri yakundaga kuza ku ishuri yakererewe. Umunsi umwe,  umwarimu 
amubazanya umujinya ati: “Kuki uhora uza kwiga ukererewe?” Undi ni ko 
kumusubiza ati: “Ni uko muvuza inzogera ntarahagera!”
5. Umukecuru yagiye gusura umwana we wari mu bitaro, nuko muganga aramubwira 
ati: “Umwuzukuru wawe ntimuri bubonane”. Umukecuru amubajije impamvu batari 
bubonane kandi yaje kureba uko ameze. Muganga amubwira ko atamubona kuko 
yagiye muri koma. Umukecuru amubaza bwangu ati: “Icyo gihugu ko ntakizi nzagerayo 
ryari?”

Umwandiko: Yamenye kubuguza
Kera habayeho umukambwe witwaga Migambi, wari uzwiho ubwenge bwinshi n’ubuhanga 
mu mukino uzwi nk’igisoro.  Umukino ukinwa n’abantu bashoboye gutekereza vuba no 
gutegura nteba. Uwo mukambwe yagiraga umuhungu umwe witwaga Minani, na we wari 
umuhanga kandi wifuzaga kumenya byinshi, cyanecyane iby’imikino yakinwaga n’abasaza.
Umunsi umwe bicaye mu ruganiriro rw’iwabo, Migambi atumira umuhungu we ngo 
bakinane igisoro, nk’uko bari basanzwe babigenza. Barakina igihe kirekire, buri 
wese yihatira gutsinda undi, ariko birangira umusaza Migambi atsinze umuhungu 
we mu buryo bugaragara. Minani arumirwa maze aramubaza ati: “Dawe, mbabarira 
umbwire. Ni nde wakwigishije kubuguza utya?” Migambi aramusubiza ati: “Ni 
Bakame wo mu Bwishaza wanyigishije amayeri yose y’igisoro.” Minani yumvise 
ayo magambo bituma amubaza ati:“Ese nange nabasha kubuguza nka Bakame?”  
Se aramusubiza “Ubishatse kandi ukabishyiraho umutima, ushobora no kumurusha.”
Minani ntiyazuyaje afata ikemezo cyo kujya i Bwishaza kwa Bakame, ngo age kumwigiraho. 
Akigerayo, Bakame aramwakira amuha amahirwe yo kumwigisha. Yahamaze amezi atatu 
yuzuye, yiga amayeri yose yo mu gisoro, akitwararika kumenya buri kantu kose.
Amaze kurangiza amasomo ye, Minani yagarutse iwabo, noneho yarabaye intyoza 
idasanzwe mu gukina igisoro. Ntigarutse wenyine, ahubwo yaje aherekejwe n’abaturanyi 
ba Bakame barimo Intare, umwami w’ishyamba n’izindi nyamaswa zaje kumushyigikira no 
kumwogeza akina.
Ageze iwabo, inkuru ye ihita iba kimomo ko yamenye kubuguza. Abasaza bose bari bafite 
amashyushyu yo gukina na we.  Barakina maze arabatsinda karahava! Bose baratangara, 
baramushima cyane. Iyo yabatsindaga, abantu bamuhaga amashyi n’impundu, imisambi 
igahiga ikamusingiza, ifundi zikamuterera ku bitugu, uduca tukamucurangira, ibirori 
bikaba birebire.
Kubera gukina neza igisoro, Minani yahawe igikombe kiza cyane, kirabagirana, kimugira 
icyamamare hose mu gihugu. Kuva ubwo ahinduka icyamamare mu gace bari batuyemo.  Si 
nge wahera, hahera umugani.

Igikorwa: Gutahura ibice bigize interuro n’imimaro yabyo

A. Ruhamwa 
Inshoza ya ruhamwa 
Ruhamwa ni ijambo rigaragaza ukora igikorwa cyangwa uwo berekezaho imimerere 
cyangwa imiterere bikubiye mu nshinga. Muri rusange ruhamwa iba igizwe n’izina ryonyine 
cyangwa ikaba igizwe n’itsinda ry’izina n’andi magambo arisobanura. Iyo dushaka kumenya 
ruhamwa, tubaza ibibazo: Ni nde? Ni iki?
Ingero: 
 ‒ Minani yamenye kubuguza. Ni nde wamenye kubuguza? Ni Minani.
 ‒ Icyo gisoro cyabajwe mu giti. Ni iki cyabajwe mu giti? Ni icyo gisoro. 
 ‒ Ababyeyi bita ku bana babo. Ni bande bita ku bana babo? Ni ababyeyi.
 ‒ Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa  agira imirimo myinshi. Ni nde ugira imirimo 
myinshi? Ni Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa.
 ‒ Umunyeshuri mwiza  yubaha abarezi n’ababyeyi. Ni nde wubaha ababyeyi? Ni 
umunyeshuri mwiza.
Muri izo nteruro, amagambo Minani, icyo gisoro, ababyeyi, Umunyamabanga 
Nshingwabikorwa, umunyeshuri mwiza afite umumaro wa ruhamwa.
B. Inshinga
Inshoza y’inshinga 
Inshinga mu nteruro ni ijambo ribumbatiye cyangwa rigaragaza igikorwa, imico, imiterere 
cyangwa imimerere bya ruhamwa. Inshinga ni yo zingiro ry’ubutumwa bukubiye mu nteruro. 
Inshinga ishobora kurema interuro yonyine kandi igatanga ubutumwa bwuzuye. Ishobora 
no kuzuzwa n’indi nshinga nta bundi bwoko bw’ijambo bukoreshejwe. 
Ingero:
 ‒ Minani yamenye kubuguza. (kumenya/yamenye)
 ‒ Minani yagarutse iwabo. (kugaruka/yagarutse)
 ‒ Minani yahawe igikombe. (Guha/yahawe)
 ‒ Icyo gisoro cyabajwe mu giti. (Kubaza/cyabajwe)

Sheja n’umuryango we bari bcdatuye mu

Yiberaga mu kazu gashaje cyane kandi nta bushobozi bwo kukavugurura yari afite. Yari

Intama ibonye impyisi ikomeje kuyifata ukuboko igira ubwoba. Igeze aho yishyiramo  
akanyabugabo iravuga iti: “Ndekura wa mugabo we nigendere ndihuta!” Impyisi yanga 
kuyirekura irayibwira iti: “Banza umbwire aho uturuka, mbone kukurekura.” Intama 
irayisubiza iti: “Ndaturuka ibwami”. Impyisi irayibaza iti: “Ibwami hari mateka ki?” 
Intama iti: “Ibwami hari amateka aca urugomo mu gihugu cyose. Umwami yategetse ngo 
impyisi ntikarye intama n’ingwe nihura n’imbwa ntikagire icyo iyitwara. Ikirura ntikikarye 
umwana w’intama. Uwagiraga amahane n’urugomo wese abireke kandi ngo uzarenga 
kuri iryo tegeko azamuhana bikomeye kuko imibanire mibi idindiza iterambere ry’igihugu 
ke.  Umwami yategetse ko amahoro akwira igihugu tugakorera hamwe tukiteza imbere.” 
Nundya uraba wanga igihugu. Kuko gukunda igihugu mbere na mbere ni uguharanira 
iterambere ryacyo.” 
Impyisi iriyumvira, igezaho iti: “Ayo mateka ntashimishije na busa. Ikindi kandi sinyitayeho. 
Nge ndakurya nibashaka bazanyice!” Intama n’ubwoba bwinshi irakomeza iti: “Ibyo 
birakureba kandi bishobora kukumerera nabi ubikinishije. Mbese ntureba uriya mugabo 
ugukurikiye?” Impyisi irahindukira ngo irebe uwo mugabo, intama irayishikuza iriruka, 
impyisi iyirukaho. Intama igenda iyibwira iti: “Reka dusiganwe numfata nakubwira iki!” 
Biragenda bigera ku iriba. Intama irarisimbuka, impyisi isimbutse igwamo. Intama ibwira 
impyisi iti: “Sinakubwiye! Ubu se urabigenza ute?” 
Nuko intama irigendera ariko igeze hirya iribwira iti: “Uwakiza iriya mpyisi nkayumvisha ko 
kugira nabi nta cyo bimaze.” Nuko rero intama iragaruka ikura ya mpyisi mu iriba. 
Impyisi iravuga iti: “Wa mwami yavuze ukuri koko! Sinari nzi ko inabi ishobora kwiturwa 
ineza! Ndabibonye koko igihugu kiyobowe neza kigira umutekano n’amahoro kikanatera 
imbere. Ngiye nange kugerageza kureka ubugome.” Intama n’impyisi bikomeza kugendana 
biganira ku mushinga byakora ngo byiteze imbere, bigeze aho byumvikana ku buhinzi 
bw’ibihumyo, inanasi, imboga, imbuto… Intama n’impyisi byigira inama yo kujya kuguza 
amafaranga ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000 Frw) nk’igishoro. Zaragurijwe maze zirahinga 
karahava. Zabigemuraga mu mpande z’igihugu cyose. Zihinduka abaherwe. 
Si nge wahera; hahera umugani.

Akanyerezo (-) gashobora gukoreshwa ahantu henshi ariko dore uburyo bune bw’ingenzi 
gakoreshwamo:

 Urugero:

 Urugero:

Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
 Inzovu yabaye iya nyuma 
Kera inzovu yibwiraga ko ari yo ihiga izindi 
nyamaswa mu kwiruka no mu mikino gakondo. 
Umunsi umwe, izamura umutonzi wayo 
ibivuga cyane inyamaswa zose ziyumvira 
icyarimwe ziriyamirira cyane. Ibibiribiri 
bibiri biri mu murima wa Mubirigi bibyumvise 
birakwenkwenuka karahava. 
Hashize akanya bivugira hamwe biti: “Yooo! 
Utazi ubwenge ashima ubwe.”
Inzovu ibyumvise ishaka kubyirukankana, birigurukira. Inyamaswa zigeze aho zigira 
inama yo kujya kubibwira intare umwami w’ishyamba ngo azabakiranure. Zigeze ibwami 
zitekerereza umwami w’ishyamba uko inzovu ihora yiyemera. Imwe muri izo nyamaswa 
iraterura ibwira umwami iti: “Kagire Imana nyagasani! Igitumye tuza kukureba ni ukugira 
ngo uzadukiranure n’inzovu. Ihora itwirariraho ngo iturusha kwiruka, ikanaduhiga mu 
mikino gakondo nko gukina igisoro, gusimbuka urukiramende, guhamya intego n’iyindi. 
Nuko umwami w’ishyamba ategura irushanwa ryo gusiganwa mu kwiruka n’iryo gusimbuka 
urukiramende.  Atumaho inyamaswa zose ngo zizaze kwitabira iryo rushanwa. Muri izo

Interuro mbonezamvugo ni iteruro idakocamye, ivugitse neza. Ni interuro ikurikiza

Inama za Bakame
Habayeho ab ana bavaga inda imwe. Umwe 
yari umukobwa undi ari umuhungu. Abo bana 
barakundanaga cyane ariko bakagira ikibazo 
cyo kugenda buhoro. Buri gihe, iyo babatumaga 
kujya gutashya inkwi mu ishyamba, batindaga 
mu nzira, bakagera mu rugo bwije. Ababyeyi 
babo bahoraga bababazwa n’iyo myitwarire 
kuko byadindizaga imirimo yo mu rugo, 
bigatuma hari iyo badakora. Ababyeyi babo 
bahoraga babibutsa ko gutinda mu nzira 
atari byiza kandi ko bakwiye kugira umuco wo 
gutebuka no gukoresha neza igihe cyabo. Nubwo 
babibwirwaga kenshi ntibigeze bisubiragaho.
Umunsi umwe, abana bicaye hamwe, baraganira. Bibaza impamvu batinda cyane mu nzira 
birabayobera. Na bo ubwabo bumvaga barambiwe guhora bababaza ababyeyi babo. Nuko bakiganira, 
Bakame, yumvise ibiganiro byabo. Iraza, irabegera maze mu bushishozi bwinshi irababwira iti: 
“Nkurikije ibyo mwavugaga, nasanze gutinda mu nzira atari ubushake bwanyu, ahubwo ari uko 
ingingo zanyu zitagororotse. Amaguru yanyu ntafite imbaraga zihagije zo kugenda yihuta. Ibyo 
bituma mugenda buhoro maze mugatinda kugera aho mujya.”
Bakame imaze kubisobanura, yahise ibereka imyitozo izabafasha kugorora ingingo no kongera 
imbaraga z’umubiri. Yabigishije gusimbuka urukiramende, kugenda makeri no kwiruka

Kera, Mahoro ntiyajyaga akora siporo cyangwa indi myidagaduro. Yamaraga iminsi ari 
wenyine, atishimye, yicaye ahantu hamwe wenyine. Ibyo byatumaga ahora yigunze, 
adatambuka neza, ndetse rimwe na rimwe akagira umunaniro. 
Nyamara, ibintu byatangiye guhinduka ubwo yamenyaga akamaro k’imyitozo ngororamubiri 
n’uruhare igira mu gutuma umuntu yishima, agira ubuzima buzira umuze kandi agakomera 
mu mubiri no mu bitekerezo. Akimara gusobanukirwa ibyo, Mahoro yigira inama yo 
guhinduka. Yihaye gahunda ihoraho yo gukora siporo buri munsi. Buri gitondo, akimara 
kubyuka, akaraba mu maso kugira ngo akanguke neza, maze akazenguruka inzu yo mu rugo 
inshuro icumi yiruka nta kuruhuka. Iyo arangije kwiruka, agenda buhorobuhoro ananura 
amaboko, amaguru n’izindi ngingo z’umubiri kugira ngo zigororoke.
Nyuma y’imyitozo, Mahoro araruhuka gato, akiyuhagira, akambara imyenda myiza, 
agatunganya aho yaraye, hanyuma agategura ibyo akeneye ku ishuri. Ubu, Mahoro 
ntakigira impumu nka mbere, ntagikererwa nk’uko byahoze. Yamenyereye kugenda vuba, 
nta gucumbagira cyangwa kugira amavunane. Siporo yatumye no mu ishuri atangira 
kwitwara neza. Yumva amasomo neza, kuko aba yaruhutse neza mu mutwe, kandi umubiri 
we ukora neza. Bagenzi be baje gutungurwa no kubona impinduka zabaye kuri Mahoro maze 
baramubaza bati: “Ko kera wahoraga wigunze, wicecekeye kandi utishimye, byagenze bite 
kugira ngo uhinduke utya?” Na we arabasubiza ati: “Byose byaturutse ku gukora siporo. 
Aho namenyeye akamaro kayo, nahise mfata ikemezo cyo kuyikora buri munsi.” 
Ibyo yababwiye byabakoze ku mutima, baramwigana, bose batangira gukora siporo. Nyuma 
y’igihe gito, bose bahinduka abana b’intyoza mu mikino.

Buri mwaka ku itariki ya mbere Gicurasi 
hizihizwa umunsi mukuru w’umurimo. 
Ni umwanya mwiza ku nzego zinyurange 
z’imirimo wo guhemba umukozi wabaye

Ndebakure ni umuhinzi w’amateke w’intangarugero. Yashyikirijwe igikombe kiza 
giherekejwe na sheki ya miriyoni mirongo itatu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Uyu muhinzi

Igihe kimwe, Ndebakure yahinze amateke menshi amupfira ubusa. Icyo gihe yayahinze 
yizeye isoko ryo mu mahanga nuko ntiyaribona. Yakomeje gutekereza uburyo ikibazo nk’icyo 
kitazongera kubabaho. Nuko ashinga uruganda ruzajya rubyaza amateke ifu, igapfunyikwa 
mu mifuka yabugenewe, ikagurishwa. Iyo fu bayikoramo igikoma, umutsima n’ibindi kandi 
ishobora kubikwa igihe kirekire. 
Uru ruganda rutangira gukora, Ndebakure yari akeneye abakozi. Nuko atanga itangazo ryo 
gupiganirwa akazi, akoresha ibizamini afata icumi babonye amanota meza. Nta kenewabo 
kiba kwa Ndebakure mu gutanga akazi. Ubuhanga n’ubushobozi ni byo bitanga akazi. 
Mu rwego rwo gutera abakozi be imbaraga, Ndebakure yashyizeho gahunda yo kuzajya 
ahemba umukozi wabaye indashyikirwa buri mwaka. Yashyizeho kandi agahimbazamusyi 
ka buri mwaka ku bakozi bakora berekana umurava, ubuhanga no guhanga udushya. 
Yakoreshaga abakozi inama kenshi, agashimira abakora neza, akagaya abashatse kudohoka 
akabumvisha ko bagomba kwisubiraho. Mu mikorere ye yirindaga cyane amarangamutima 
n’ikenewabo.  Wasangaga abakozi b’uruganda bakorana ubushake kubera izo ngamba zari 
zarashyizweho.
Mu gihe k’imyaka itanu, uruganda rwari rumaze gutera intambwe ishimishije. Umusaruro 
warwo wari umaze kwikuba inshuro zirenga icumi. Ni ku bw’iyo mpamvu rwahawe igihembo 
mu rwego rw’Igihugu kubera imikorere myiza.

6.8. Ibaruwa mbonezamubano(Ibaruwa ya gicuti)
Igikorwa cya 1: Gutahura inshoza n’uturango by’ibaruwa mbonezamubano
Ongera usome umwandiko “Inama z’umubyeyi” maze witegereze ibaruwa irimo 
hanyuma utahure icyo ibaruwa ari cyo kandi utahure uturango twayo. 
A. Inshoza y’ibaruwa mbonezamubano
Ibaruwa ni urupapuro rwanditseho ubutumwa umuntu yoherereza undi batari kumwe. 
Ibaruwa “Inama z’umubyeyi” ni ibaruwa mbonezamubano. Ibaruwa mbonezamubano 
ni ibaruwa bamwe bita ibaruwa ya gishuti cyangwa ibaruwa isanzwe. Umuntu ayandikira 
undi agamije kumumenyesha amakuru, kumugira inama cyangwa kumubaza amakuru ye. 
Ingero:
 ‒ Ibaruwa umuntu yandikira inshuti ye.
 ‒ Ibaruwa umubyeyi yandikira umwana we.
 ‒ Ibaruwa umwana yandikira ababyeyi be, abavandimwe.
B. Uturango tw’ibaruwa mbonezamubano
Ibaruwa mbonezamubano irangwa n’ibice bikurikira: 
1. Aderesi y’uwandika:  Uwandika n’aho abarizwa. Byandikwa hejuru mu nguni 
y’ibumoso bw’urupapuro. 
2. Ahantu n’itariki ibaruwa yandikiweho:  Byandikwa hejuru mu nguni, iburyo 
bw’urupapuro.
3. Amagambo ahamagara uwandikiwe: Ni amagambo ahamagara, uwandika asa n’aho 
asaba uwandikiwe guhuguka ngo yakire ubutumwa. Icyo gice cyandikwa munsi hasi 
cyane ariko kiringaniye n’ahantu n’itariki.
4. Indamukanyo:  Ni igika gikubiyemo indamukanyo uwanditse aha uwo yandikiye 
n’amakuru make ku miterere y’ubuzima bwe n’ubw’umuryango. Iki gice gitangirira 
munsi neza y’aho amagambo ahamagara uwandikiwe atangirira.
5. Ubutumwa butangwa:  Ni igika kirimo ubutumwa uwandika ashaka kugeza ku 
wandikiwe. 
6. Gusezera: Igika gisoza ibaruwa, gisezera kirimo n’ibyiza uwandika yifuriza uwo 
yandikiye.
7. Kuvuga isano iri hagati y’uwanditse n’uwandikiwe
8. Izina ry’uwanditse ibaruwa 
9. Umukono w’uwanditse ibaruwa.

6.9. Umwandiko: Inka na Nyarubwana
Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko 
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
Inka na Nyarubwana
Kera habayeho inyamaswa yitwa Nyarubwana 
yari ituranye n’inka. Iyi Nyarubwana 
ntiyakundaga gukora nk’izindi nyamaswa. 
Yari yarabaye umudari; yarahorose  cyane 
kubera kubura ibyo irya. Iyo inka yarebaga 
Nyarubwana iri guhunahuna amayezi 
yayigiriraga impuhwe bikanayishengura 
cyane.
Umunsi umwe inka yagerageje kwegera Nyarubwana maze igerageza kuyiganiriza.
 ‒ Ko mbona utagicira ngo agwe urumva utagiye gupfa? Wagerageje gukora ukabona 
ibigutunga! 
 ‒ Ibyo uvuga uranjwa! Nimfa se uzahomba iki?
 ‒ Nzaba mpombye umuzimyamuriro wange.
 ‒ Iririre n’abawe nge undeke. 
Inka irigendera ariko biyanga mu nda. Yigira inama yo kuzagaruka undi munsi ikongera 
ikayigira inama. Nyarubwana isigara aho yibaza ku byo inka iyibwiye. Mu mutima yarimo 
yibwira iti: “Nzapfa se nte kandi abaturanyi bange bejeje. Asyi! Nzarya ibyabo.” 
Hafi aho intare yari ihejeje ibigori byinshi. Nimugoroba Nyarubwana ifata agafuka yerekeza 
mu murima w’intare ngo ice ibigori. Igezemo itangira kwitegereza ibyeze neza bitaruma 
ikabica ibishyira mu gafuka. Ikirimo kubica, yumva intare iratontomye, Nyarubwana ita 
agafuka hasi ifumyamo iriruka. Yirutse amasigamana maze ijya kwihisha mu kiraro k’inka. 
Inka iyibonye irabira cyane iyibaza impamvu ifite igihunga kinshi. Nyarubwana irayisubiza 
iti: “Naciye ibigori mu murima w’intare iranyirukankana, mbabarira umpishe.” Inka iba 
ibonye undi mwanya wo kongera kuyigira inama. Iyisobanurira akamaro ko gukunda 
umurimo n’ingaruka z’ubunebwe.  
Mu gihe inka yari ikiyisobanurira, intare iba irahasesekaye yarubiye. Nyarubwana ngo 
iyikubite amaso ubwoba burayitaha irapfukama iyisaba imbabazi igira iti: “Mbabarira irya 
none sinzongera kwiba. Nabiterwaga n’ubunebwe, none inka imaze kunsobanurira ingaruka 
zabwo. Kuva ubu ngiye kwisubiraho. Mbabarira ndabigusabye.”  
Intare irayibabarira inayikwikirira isuka iyiha n’imbuto yo kuzatera. Inka na yo iyemerera 
kuzayiha imibyizi. Nyarubwana irumvira, mu gitondo kare, itangira kujya izinduka ikajyana 
n’inka guhinga. Irahinga hashize igihe ireza. Imyaka yejeje irayitunga, inasagurira 
amasoko. Kuva ubwo, Nyarubwana yitabira guhinga cyane. Icika ku bunebwe igira umwete 
nk’izindi nyamaswa nuko ibaho neza.

Ku wa Gatandatu ushize, Umuyobozi w’Akarere yasuye ikigo cyacu. Yatuganirije ku 
byiza by’umurimo wo kwiga dushinzwe. Umuyobozi w’ikigo cyacu wari uyoboye gahunda

Banyeshuri bagenzi bange! Muraho!
Nitwa Mutezinka Rita nkaba niga ku kigo cy’Urwunge rw’Amashuri rwa Kivumu mu mwaka 
wa kane w’amashuri abanza.
Munyemerere mbabwire ijambo riri ku mutima wange. Ndashimira Imana yo yaturemye 
tukaba turiho, ndashimira abayobozi bo mu nzego za Leta badutegurira gahunda nziza

Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza.
Yaretse ubunebwe
Bakame na Kanyamasyo bari baturanye. 
Bakame yahingaga imboga n’imbuto nyinshi, 
Kanyamasyo akorora inkoko nyinshi, izitanga 
inyama n’izitanga amagi.
Umunsi umwe, Kanyamasyo yagiye gusura 
Bakame. Bakame amutembereza mu mirima 
ye, amwereka imbuto n’imboga biramunezeza. 
Bakame aramubwira ati: “Izi mboga n’imbuto 
byange bifite akamaro cyane.
Mbigaburira abana bange, ibisagutse nkabigurisha nkabona amafaranga yo kugura 
ibindi biribwa ntafite. Bituma abana bange batarwaragurika kuko bafata indyo yuzuye.” 
Kanyamasyo na we aravuga ati: “Nge noroye inkoko. Ngaburira abana bange inyama n’amagi 
ariko mbasoromera n’imboga zimejeje mu ntanzi z’urugo maze bakarisha ibinyabijumba. 
Abana bange kandi njya mbaha ku binyampeke ngura ku isoko nagurishije inkoko. Abana 
bange bahorana imbaraga kandi batsinda neza mu ishuri.”
Bakame na Kanyamasyo bakomeje kuganira. Nuko Bakame aza kuganyira Kanyamasyo ko 
Warupyisi yamuzahaje amwibira imboga n’imbuto. Nuko Kamasyo ariyamira ati: “Yebaba 
weee! Nange Warupyisi yaranzahaje! Dore n’ejobundi yantwariye isake yari igeze igihe cyo 
kugurishwa.” Bakomeje kuganira, Kanyamasyo ageze aho arasezera arataha.
Mu nzira ataha, ahura na Warupyisi avuye kumwiba indi inkoko. Kanyamasyo 
aramwirukankana ngo: “Diridiri! Diridiri! Diridiri!” Warupyisi aramusiga. Kanyamasyo 
asubira kureba Bakame, amubwira ko ahuye na Warupyisi yongeye kumwibira inkoko.

Umwandiko: Inzu z’utugurube dutatu
Habayeho utugurube dutatu twiberaga mu ishyamba, maze tugakundana cyane. Nyina 
yadutozaga kwitabira imirimo no kurwanya ubunebwe, agato kakaba akanyamurava. 
Umunsi umwe twaricaye, kamwe kati: “Mureke twubake inzu tuzituremo.” Ak’akanebwe 
kati: “Icyo gitekerezo ni kiza ahubwo ejo tuzarare tuzujuje.” Kubera ubunebwe kagiraga, 
bwarakeye kubaka inzu y’ibyatsi. Akandi karagaseka ngo kubatse inzu yoroshye maze 
ko kubaka iy’ibiti. Karumuna katwo ko kagiraga umurava maze kubaka inzu ikomeye 
y’amatafari. 
Ntibyatinze ikirura kiradutera, gihera ku kagurube kubatse inzu y’ibyatsi. Ikirura 
cyarakomanze kanga kugikingurira, gihita gihuha ka kazu karatumuka. Akagurube gahita 
gahungira kuri kagenzi kako kubatse inzu y’ibiti gatabaza cyane. Ikirura cyaragakurikiye 
gifite amerwe, gisunikana imbaraga ya nzu y’ibiti iragwa. Utugurube turasimbuka duhungira 
kwa karumuna katwo kubatse inzu y’amatafari. Ikirura kihageze nticyabasha kuyisenya, 
kiramwara kiragenda. Utwo tugurube twashimiye karumuna katwo kadukirije amagara.
Ako kagurube ka gatatu kagira turumuna twako inama. Karatubwira kati: “Twari twihaye 
umurimo wo kwiyubakira inzu, mwebwe kubera ubunebwe mwubaka inzu zidakomeye. 
Ngewe nubaka inzu ikomeye. None muraboba ko inzu yange ibarokoye. Umurimo muzajya 
mukora wose, muzage muwunoza. Ni bwo muzagera ku byo mugamije byose.”  Kuva ubwo 
utugurube twose twiyemeza kureka ubunebwe maze na two twiyubakira inzu zikomeye.

IJAMBO RY’IBANZE
Munyeshuri,
Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze runejejwe no kukugezaho igitabo 
k’Ikinyarwanda, umwaka wa gatanu w’amashuri abanza. Iki gitabo cyateguwe hagamijwe 
gushyira mu bikorwa Integanyanyigisho Ishingiye ku Bushobozi (CBC) kugira ngo uhabwe 
uruhare mu myigire yawe. Ibyo bigamije kugutegurira gukomeza kwiga amashuri yawe 
kugira ngo wunguke ubumenyi, ubumenyingiro n’ubukesha bizagufasha kwihangira 
umurimo no kuba Umunyarwanda mwiza. Mu kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi, Leta y’u Rwanda 
ishyira imbaraga mu gutegura imfashanyigisho zijyanye n’integanyanyigisho kugira ngo 
zizagufashe mu myigire yawe. 
Nk’uko u Rwanda rukomeje kwiyubaka rugana ku bukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi, uburezi 
ni inkingi ya mwamba muri urwo rugendo rwo kwiyubaka. Abarimu bazagira uruhare mu 
kukuyobora ku bumenyi bujyanye n’ubuzima busanzwe bwa buri munsi. Ibyo bizagufasha 
kwiteza imbere no guteza imbere Igihugu muri rusange.
Iki gitabo cy’umunyeshuri ni imfashanyigisho nziza izagufasha kwiga neza isomo 
ry’ Ikinyarwanda mu mwaka wa gatanu w’amashuri abanza. Iri somo ni ingenzi mu gushyira 
mu bikorwa Integanyanyigisho Ishingiye ku Bushobozi kuko rizatanga ubumenyi, ubumenyi 
ngiro n’ubukesha bikenewe kugira ngo uzabe umuturage ushoboye kandi w’inyangamugayo. 
Uzagira ubushobozi mu kwikemurira ibibazo no guhanga udushya dukenewe mu muryango 
mugari. 
Ndashimira byimazeyo buri wese wagize uruhare mu kwandika no mu kunoza iki gitabo. 
Ndashimira by’umwihariko itsinda rya REB ryayoboye iki gikorwa kuva kigitangira kugeza 
kirangiye. Turashimira kandi abafatanyabikorwa bose, abarimu n’abandi bose bagize 
uruhare muri uru rugendo.  Ibitekerezo byanyu birakenewe mu gukomeza kunoza iki gitabo 
kugira ngo imyigire y’abanyeshuri bacu irusheho kuba myiza.

Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REB

Intangiriro
Muri uyu mutwe hakubiyemo imyandiko ivuga ku muco nyarwanda. Urashishikarizwa 
kuyisoma no kugira umuco nyarwanda aho uri hose. Harimo kandi ingwizanyito 
n’imvugwakimwe, amasaha, amezi n’ibihe bya kinyarwanda, indamukanyo za kinyarwanda 
ndetse n’amagambo aranga ahantu. 
Soma-Tekereza
Arangije umwaka wa kane w’amashuri abanza, Karenzi yateze imodoka ashaka kujya 
mu mugi. Amaze kuyigeramo, aricara. Hashize umwanya muto, muri ya modoka hinjira 
umubyeyi uhetse umwana. Ahagarara iruhande rwa Karenzi kuko imyanya yo kwicaramo 
yari yashize. Umushoferi wari utwaye imodoka, asaba Karenzi kwimukira uwo mubyeyi. 
Karenzi mu bukana bwinshi, ati: “Nagezemo mbere kandi nishyuye ayange. Sinahaguruka, 
ntimukage mutumenyera!” Abari mu modoka bose barakebuka, bamureba bumiwe.
Uhereye ku nkuru ya Karenzi mu modoka, subiza ibibazo bikurikira:
a) Iyo uba Karenzi wari gukora iki? Sobanura igisubizo cyawe.
b) Tanga izindi ngero eshatu z’imyifatire yimakaza ubwubahane hagati y’abantu 
n’abandi.

n’indangagaciro nyarwanda ndetse 
banaganira no ku mahame remezo Igihugu

Ntwari ni we watangiye ikiganiro agira ati:

Ubwo turata ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda tukaniyemeza kuzaruteza imbere. Mu ndirimbo 
yubahiriza Igihugu, twiyemeza guharanira amahoro no kurinda ibyiza tumaze kugeraho.”
Kamariza yakurikiyeho maze aravuga ati: “Uvuze iby’iyi ndirimbo yubahiriza Igihugu mpita 
nibuka ibyo ababyeyi batuganirije. Ababyeyi batubwiye ko dufite isoko imwe duhuriyeho yo 
kuba turi Abanyarwanda. Batubwiye ko tugomba kubana kivandimwe, tugakundana kandi 
tugafashanya. Bityo rero, nta Munyarwanda ukwiye kubura umufasha kandi twese turi 
abavandimwe.” 
Muhire wari wakurikiye ikiganiro cya Ntwari na Kamariza, yahise aterura ikiganiro maze 
ataka Igihugu cy’ u Rwanda. Nuko atangira agira ati: “Ibyo muvuze byose ni ukuri kandi ni 
byiza ariko hari ibyo nange nabonye ku Rwanda. U Rwanda ni Igihugu kiza kandi n’abaturage 
barwo ni beza. Bose bubakiye ku ndangagaciro remezo ari zo gukunda Igihugu, ubumwe, 
ubupfura no gukunda umurimo. Barangwa n’urukundo, gufashanya no gutabarana. Igihugu 
cyacu kandi gifite amahame remezo kigenderaho. Muri ayo mahame harimo nko ‘gukumira 
no guhana icyaha cya jenoside, kurwanya ihakana n’ipfobya bya jenoside no kurandura 
burundu ingengabitekerezo ya jenoside n’ibyo igaragariramo byose’. Dufite amahirwe yo 
kuba twaravukiye mu Rwanda.”
Ntwari wari watangiye ikiganiro ni we wagishoje agira ati: “Mureke tuvome dutahe, ubu

1.4. Umwandiko: Ndabaga
 Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
 Ndabaga
Ndabaga ni umukobwa wa Nyamutezi mu 
Bwishaza mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba. 
Ndabaga yavutse ari ikinege. Akiri uruhinja, 
se Nyamutezi yagiye ku rugerero kandi 
nta muvandimwe yagiraga washoboraga 
kumukura. Bityo ntiyashoboraga kuva ku 
rugerero hatabonetse uwo kumusimbura. 
Amaze guca akenge, Ndabaga yabajije 
nyina aho se aba maze nyina amusubiza ko 
aba mu rugerero.
Ndabaga ati: “None se ko adataha?” Nyina ati: “Ni uko adafite umwana w’umuhungu 
cyangwa umuvandimwe wo kumukura.” 
Ndabaga yatangiye kwitoza imirimo ya gihungu nko gusimbuka, kwiruka, kurasa, gutera 
icumu no gufora umuheto. Ibyo yabikoraga ategura kuzajya gucungura se ku rugerero. 
Si byo gusa, Ndabaga yagiye no mu bacuzi kwimenesha no gushiririza amabere ngo 
atazapfundura hakagira umenya ko ari umukobwa. 
Ndabaga amaze gukuka ubwangavu, abwira nyina ati: “Ndifuza kujya kureba data ngo 
turamukanye kandi mucungure ku rugerero.” Nyina amupfunyikira impamba, akurikira 
abandi banyabwishaza bagemuriye ababo ku rugerero. 
Akigerayo, Ndabaga yasabye abahungu b’ikigero ke kumwereka Nyamutezi. 
Baramumwereka bararamukanya, baribwirana, baranezerwa. Ndabaga ati: “Ese mubyeyi 
wabujijwe n’iki kujya mu rugo?” Se ati: “Mwana wange nabuze unkura.” Ndabaga ni ko 
kumubwira ati: “Ntuvuge ko ndi umukobwa, uvuge ko ndi umuhungu kuko imirimo ya 
gihungu nyizi.” Se ati: “Ubwo se iyo ushoboye ni nk’iyihe?” Ndabaga arayimurondorera. 
Nyamutezi ashaka kumuhinyuza, amushingira intego, amuha umuheto ngo arebe ko 
ashobora kumasha. Ndabaga arayimasha arayihamya. Amuha icumu ati: “Ngaho tera 
hariya ndebe ko uhageza.” Ndabaga aratera araharenza. Se aramushimira, amumurikira 
umugenga w’ urugerero ati: “Nguyu umukura wange.” Nyamutezi baramureka arataha.
Ndabaga yiga imyiyereko yari iriho icyo gihe arayimenya. Nuko aba intore ikundwa kandi 
ishimwa cyane bituma agabana inka nyinshi. Abana bari ku rugerero bamugirira ishyari 
kuko abatanze kugabana inka nyinshi kandi aje vuba. Ab’iwabo bamuzi bakajya bajujura 
bati: “Ubonye Ndabaga ngo araturusha kugabana inka nyinshi kandi ari umukobwa.”

Inkuru yaje kugera ku mwami ko Ndabaga ari umukobwa. Umwami aramutumira ngo 
abyimenyere by’ impamo maze atangira guhata Ndabaga ibibazo. Ati: “Ndabaga uri 
umukobwa cyangwa uri umuhungu?” Ndabaga aho gusubiza, ubwoba buramutaha. 
Yatekerezaga ko nabeshya umwami bizamubera icyaha agata se mu mazi abira na we 
atiretse.  Ikindi nanone atinya kuvugisha ukuri ngo atamubaza icyatumye aza mu rugerero. 
Umwami amurembeje ahitamo kumubwiza ukuri ati: “Ndi umukobwa.” Umwami amubaza 
impamvu yaje mu rugerero. Ndabaga aramusubiza ati: “Nabyirutse ntabona data. Mama 
ambwira ko ari ku rugamba kandi ko adafite umuhungu wo kumukura. Nahise niga imirimo 
ya gihungu ngo nzamukure. Maze kuyimenya naje kumukura, arataha.”
Umwami amaze kumva amagambo ya Ndabaga, atumiza Nyamutezi, amubaza niba umwana 
we ari umukobwa cyangwa ari umuhungu. Nyamutezi abanza kujijinganya nk’umukobwa 
we ariko ageze aho avugisha ukuri, abwira umwami ko ari umukobwa. Amusobanurira 
ko yari amaze kunanirwa kubera ubusaza kandi ko nta wundi yari afite wo kumukura.  
Umwami yaramuhumurije, amuha inka nyinshi, aramusezerera arataha. Kuva ubwo 
Ndabaga ahita ajyanwa ibwami arererwayo. Amaze kuba inkumi umwami aramurongora, 
aramukundwakaza cyane.
Kuva icyo gihe, umwami aca iteka ko ibinege bitagira gikura bizajya bisezererwa bigataha 
nta yandi mananiza.

Kamanzi: Ibyo uvuga ni ko byagendaga ariko ntibikwiye gukomeza. Isi yarahindutse. Ubu 
abana bose bagomba kugira amahirwe angana. Umukobwa ashobora kuba umusirikari,

gukubura, gukoropa, guteka n’indi.   Ibi bigaragaza ko tugomba kuva mu bitekerezo 
bishingiye ku muco kandi bidaha abantu amahirwe angana. Ibyiza byo mu muco tugomba 
kubikomeza ariko ibitudindiza tukabireka.
Kamariza: Kamanzi rero, ni byiza ko twita ku muco n’indangagacirobyacu. Iyo umukobwa 
yita ku rugo, atetse, yambitse abana, aba yubahirije umurage w’abakurambere. Kuki 
twifuza kwigana iby’ahandi no gutesha agaciro ibyo dusanganywe?

ze. Niba umukobwa ashaka gutwara indege, ni amahitamo ye. Uyu munsi dukeneye 
uburinganire, aho imirimo ishingira ku bushobozi, aho gushingira ku gitsina. Naho ubundi,

nde uzita ku bana? Ni nde uzarinda umuryango? Iyo buri wese akora akazi agenewe mu

Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko  
 Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
Amasaha ya kinyarwanda
Kera amasaha ya kizungu ataragera 
mu Rwanda, Abanyarwanda bari bafite 
uburyo bwabo bwo gupima igihe. Icyo gihe, 
bifashishaga amasaha ya kinyarwanda, 
bashingiye ku izuba no ku bikorwa 
by’ubuzima bwa buri munsi. Ayo masaha 
ntabwo yerekanaga igihe gihamye kimwe 
buri munsi nk’uko amasaha ya kizungu 
abikora. Byaterwaga n’uko umunsi uteye, 
ahantu umuntu aherereye n’imirimo akora.
Amasaha ya kinyarwanda atangirira igihe izuba rirashe, ni ukuvuga ahagana saa kumi 
n’ebyiri za mu gitondo. Icyo gihe ni bwo abantu batangiraga imirimo yabo, cyanecyane 
abahinzi n’aborozi. Iyo izuba ryabaga ryarenze, ni bwo batangiraga kubara amasaha 
y’ijoro. 
Amasaha ya kinyarwanda yashoboraga gutandukana bitewe n’uduce tw’Igihugu. Aho 
izuba rirasira, amasaha bayatangiraga kare. Ibi byaterwaga n’uko nta bipimo by’amasaha 
bihamye babaga bafite, ahubwo bagendaga bareba uko izuba ryitwara, uko ibihe bihagaze, 
ndetse n’ibikorwa biri kubera aho batuye.

bati: “Ku gasusuruko, izuba rihumbye, izuba rya kiberinka, izuba ry’igishukabaja”. Ibi

Inshoza y’indamukanyo
Indamukanyo ni imvugo y’ubupfura ikoreshwa iyo abantu bahuye mbere yo kugira ikindi 
baganira. Mu muco nyarwanda, habaho gusuhuzanya (gusuhuza) no kuramukanya 
(kuramutsa).  Iyo abantu batandukanye basezeranaho. 
a) Kuramukanya
Kuramukanya ni uburyo bwo gukoresha amagambo yabugenewe mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda 
wifuriza uwo muhuye ibyiza. Mu muco nyarwanda, umuntu mukuru ni we uramutsa umuntu 
mutoya, umugore akaba ari we uramutsa umugabo. Nta mwana uramutsa umuntu mukuru 
kimwe n’uko nta mugabo uramutsa umugore.
b) Gusuhuzanya 
Gusuhuzanya ni umuco w’ubupfura uranga abantu igihe bahuye. Gusuhuzanya bikorwa 
na buri wese. Umuto ashobora gusuhuza umuntu mukuru cyangwa umukuru agasuhuza 
umuntu mutoya. 
c) Gusezeranaho
Gusezeranaho ni umuco w’ubupfura uranga abantu bari kumwe maze bagatandukana. Iyo 
bagiye gutandukana, umwe asezera ku wundi bakabona kugenda.

Umuco n’indangagaciro nyarwanda
Umuco ni inkingi ikomeye y’ubuzima bw’Abanyarwanda kuva na kera. Ugizwe n’imyitwarire, 
imyemerere, imyambarire, n’imibanire y’abantu. Indangagaciro ni imyitwarire myiza 
umuntu agendana igaragaza icyubahiro n’ubupfura. Mu muco nyarwanda, ubupfura 
ni ishingiro ry’uburere. Iyo umwana atojwe akiri muto kuvuga ati: “Muraho” cyangwa 
“Mwiriwe” arabikurana maze bikaba ikimenyetso kerekana kubaha no gukunda abantu.
Umuco w’ubupfura ukomoka mu muryango, ukagera mu mashuri no mu muryango mugari.  
Hari imigenzo myiza igaragaza ubupfura mu bantu nko gusabana no gusangira n’abandi. 
Iyo umuturanyi yagize ibibazo, abandi baramwegera bakamukomeza. Ibi byubaka ubumwe 
n’ubufatanye mu muryango nyarwanda. 
Mu gihe cyashize, abana bubahaga cyane ababyeyi n’abarezi. Nta mwana watinyukaga 
kuvuga nabi cyangwa kwitwara nabi imbere y’umuntu mukuru. Iyo yabikoraga, 
yagirwaga inama cyangwa agahabwa igihano kimufasha kwisubiraho. Umuntu urangwa 
n’ubunyangamugayo, ubudahemuka, n’urukundo ahabwa icyubahiro mu muryango we no 
mu muryango nyarwanda.
Kwigisha abana gukunda no kugendera ku muco no ku ndangagaciro zawo ni inshingano 
z’ababyeyi n’abarezi. Abana bato bagomba kwigishwa kuvugisha ukuri no kwitanga.

kureka ishuri. Nuko ahitamo kujya gucukura amabuye y’agaciro mu buryo butemewe kuko mu gace

wabo Mudage. Izo nka zarishaga mu ishyamba ry’abaturage kandi zikaryangiza cyane. Hari 
n’ubwo zahirikaga amabuye ku nzu z’abaturage. Uyu mushumba na we kandi yakundaga kwangiza 
ibisheke n’indi myaka y’abaturage kugira ngo abone icyo kurya. Mu gihe yabaga akeneye kujya 
ku bwiherero yitumaga mu ishyamba. Uwo mwanda washokeraga mu kabande umanukanywe

2.1. Umwandiko: Dusobanukirwe n’ibidukikije 
Igikorwa cya 1: Gusoma umwandiko
Soma umwandiko ukurikira wubahiriza utwatuzo n’isesekaza:
Dusobanukirwe n’ibidukikije 
Umunsi umwe, ku wa Gatanu, abana bayobora itsinda ryo kubungabunga ibidukikije ku ishuri 
ryabo, bahuriye mu kibuga k’iryo shuri baganira ku bidukikije. Iryo tsinda ryari rigizwe na 
Rugwiro, Karangwa, Isheja na Nyiraneza. Baganiriye ku byo bungutse mu masomo yabo 
maze bagaragaza urukundo n’ubushake bwo kubungabunga ibidukikije by’u Rwanda. 
Rugwiro ni we watangiye agira ati: “Ibidukikije ni ibintu byose bikikije aho dutuye. Muri 
byo, harimo ibinyabuzima n’ibitari ibinyabuzima. Mu bidukikije harimo amazi, amashyamba, 
imisozi, inyamaswa n’ibimera byose.” Yarakomeje ati: “Amazi tuyasanga mu migezi yacu nka

Nyabarongo, Akagera, Rusizi n’iyindi. Tuyasanga kandi mu biyaga nka Kivu, Muhazi cyangwa 
Burera na Ruhondo. Mu mashyamba dusangamo Nyungwe, Akagera, Cyamudongo...Dufite 
imisozi nka Ndiza, Jali, Suti n’iyindi myinshi itandukanye. Mu bidukikije kandi dusangamo 
inyamaswa z’nk’intare n’imbogo.” 
Karangwa na we yungamo ati: “Iyo tutita ku bidukikije, bishobora kwangirika bikaduteza 
ibiza n’ibindi bibazo. Urugero nk’amazi ni ubuzima. Turayanywa, tuyakoresha mu mirimo 
yo mu rugo no mu buhinzi. Amashyamba aduha umwuka mwiza duhumeka, kandi arinda 
ubutaka gusatagurika. Inyamaswa zacu, uretse kuba ari ibidukikije, zifasha mu kurinda 
ubusumbane bw’ibinyabuzima kandi zituma igihugu kibona amafaranga binyuze mu 
bukerarugendo. Imisozi yacu n’amashyamba bifasha mu kubungabunga imvura, bikanatuma 
tugira ikirere kiza. 
Isheja azamura akaboko na we afata umwanya ati: “Reka nange mbunganire. Amashyamba 
atanga umwuka mwiza duhumeka kandi aba aturinda isuri. Iyo bayatemye, ubutaka buruma, 
mu gihe k’imvura bukarengerwa n’amazi kandi n’inyamaswa zayabagamo zikabura intaho. 
Tugira kandi ibirunga na pariki ziriho amashyamba bireshya abashyitsi basura u Rwanda. 
Dukwiye rero gutera ibiti aho bishoboka hose kandi tukirinda gutema amashyamba ku 
buryo butemewe.” 
Nyiraneza wari ucecetse gato, na we atanga igitekerezo ke, ati: “Imisozi yacu ni isoko 
y’uburanga n’ubukerarugendo. Hari imisozi miremire mu Rwanda bikikijwe n’amashyamba. 
Tugira kandi udusozi twinshi ndetse n’ibishanga mu bice byinshi by’u Rwanda. Ngira ngo ni 
na yo mpamvu u Rwanda rwitwa Igihugu k’imisozi igihumbi.” 
Mu kiganiro cya Rugwiro, Karangwa, Isheja na Nyiraneza bose bahurira ku kamaro 
k’ibidukikije kuko bitanga umwuka duhumeka, ibiribwa n’imiti. Ibidukikije bibungabunga 
uburanga bw’igihugu, bituma haboneka imvura n’ikirere kiza, ndetse bituma igihugu kiba 
ahantu heza ho gutura no gusurwa n’abakerarugendo. 
Ubu bose biyemeje kugira uruhare mu kurengera ibidukikije bakora ibikorwa bitandukanye 
nko kwegeranya imyanda no kuyijyana ahabugenewe, gutera ibiti mu ngo no ku mashuri no 
gusaba abandi kudatemagura amashyamba. Biyemeje kandi kuzajya bashishikariza bagenzi 
babo kwita ku bidukikije kuko ari umurage ukwiye gusigasirwa. Mu gusoza, bafatanye mu 
biganza maze baravuga bati: “Kurinda ibidukikije ni ukurinda ubuzima bwacu!”

B. Ubwoko bw’amagambo akatwa
Mu Kinyarwanda, hari ubwoko bubiri bw’amagambo akatwa. Ayo magambo ni ibyungo 
nka na na n’ibinyazina ngenera bisozwa n’inyajwi “a”.
Icyungo na n’icyungo nka ndetse n’ibinyazina ngenera bisozwa n’inyajwi “a” birakatwa 
iyo bikurikiwe n’ijambo ritangiwe n’inyajwi. Inyajwi ya nyuma ya na cyangwa iya nka 
cyangwa iy’ikinyazina ngenera gisozwa na “a” ikurwaho igasimburwa n’agakato (’) iyo 
ibanjirije ijambo ritangiwe n’inyajwi. Ibinyazina ngenera bisozwa n’inyajwi “ a” ni, wa, 
ba, rya, ya, cya, bya,  za, rwa, ka, twa, bwa, kwa ndetse na ha.
